crossRefs.note: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

translations.web: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
translations.bsb: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
translations.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see
translations.asv: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
